about.description: With a background in animation and a passion for creating visually compelling content, I specialize in motion design and video editing. I've collaborated with a variety of clients, from media broadcast networks to social media influencers, helping them elevate their brands with high-quality visuals. Drawing, anime, and Asian culture inspire my creativity, and I love taking on new challenges to bring ideas to life.
